 Hon'Ble Pankaj Bhatia, J. 
1.

Heard learned Counsel for the applicant as well as learned A.G.A. and Sri Imran Asim Khan,
learned Counsel for the opposite party no.2.
2.
The FIR in question was lodged alleging the offence of Section 376, 377, 506 IPC, in which, a charge-sheet was filed.
Subsequently, a counter affidavit has been filed along with the affidavit of the deponent/ victim, wherein, she stated that nothing wrong was done to her as alleged in the FIR.

3. Considering the affidavit submitted by the victim coupled with the nature of the allegation which inherently arises out of some disputes inter se in between the parties, no useful purpose would be served in keeping the matter pending, as such, the proceedings initiated in pursuance to the Charge-sheet dated 11.03.20219 arising out of FIR No.98 of 2018, Police Station Ashiyana, District Lucknow are quashed.
(Pankaj Bhatia,J.) February 2, 2026 akverma  Sharik Hussain vs State Of U.P. Thru. Prin. Secy. Home.
